scope: Damaged RTCW MP demos: the 2026-09-18 fault corpus of both RTCW MP recordings played in full by fnTech3 and by retail WolfMP.exe 1.41

probe.change: --retail now also plays rtcw-mp in the installation WolfMP.exe, whose console log is main/rtcwconsole.log
probe.probeCfg:
set cl_allowDownload 0
set cl_motd 0
set com_introplayed 1
set timedemo 1
set fault_tick "echo FAULT_DEMO_TICK; wait 100; vstr fault_tick"
demo fault
vstr fault_tick

client.build: debugoptimized Windows x86 export of baseCommit plus the RTCW entity-query change, every development gate on
client.note: result.json files name the repository HEAD at run time (37b87dce), not the export

retail.settings: fs_basepath installation, fs_homepath a scratch folder, r_fullscreen 0, r_mode 3, in_mouse 0, in_joystick 0, in_nograb 1, s_initsound 0, logfile 2

retailRecording.origin: recorded by retail WolfMP.exe on a pure fnTech3 server on mp_beach (2026-09-18-demo-faults.json sourceDemos.rtcw-mp-retail)

fntech3Recording.origin: recorded by fnTech3 on mp_beach (2026-09-18-demo-faults.json sourceDemos.rtcw-mp-fntech3)

environment: Windows 11; each variant a fresh process and isolated home, windowed on an unswitched private desktop, sound and mouse/joystick input off, console commands only; the installation unchanged after every run
inferences: Every variant retail rejected, fnTech3 rejected, and every variant retail completed, fnTech3 completed, except a record length of -2, which retail ends as a truncation and fnTech3 rejects, as the invalid-length checkpoint chose for every profile.
The two retail crashes and two retail stalls are corruptions fnTech3 rejects by its decoder checks: a truncated player-state delta (three) and an area mask of 254 bytes.
